positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - [Android,Frontend/Backend]
positions.description:
Android Development (Native)
Solo android developer incharge of the following
- Implemented new features and improve existing ones by working with Product and QA teams
- Established a new clean architecture with reactive programming
- Have been using kotlin for past 4 years and have migrated 90% of code from java to Kotlin
- Established a Continuous Integrations for app builds on AWS
- Implemented/Deployed 3 different apps with different product flavors
- Bug monitoring and fixes (fabric, firebase)
- Tech Stack: Kotlin, Java, Retrofit 2, Dagger 2, RxJava/RxKotlin, Picasso, FacebookSDK, GCM, AWS (CI), Swagger, Zeplin, Sketch, Crashlytics/Fabric

Web Development (Frontend and Backend)
- Implemented new features on ReactJS based frontend web application 
- Implemented/deployed a microservice with NodeJS
- Implemented new endpoints to existing .NET backend web api
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Web Development · Android Development · Android SDK
